issue_context.title: TextHelper highlight does sanitisation incorrectly
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce
```ruby
highlight("xxx yyy & zzz", "a")
```

### Expected behavior
Sanitisation is done on each matched / not matched part of the string separately. This results in:
```
"xxx yyy & zzz"
```

### Actual behavior
The whole string is sanitised before the highlighting which results in:
```
"xxx yyy &<mark>a</mark>mp; zzz"
```

Instead of sanitising the whole string at once, `highlight` could do something like:

-    split the string into matching / not matching parts
-    escape each part separately
-    wrap the matching parts in `<mark>...</mark>`
-    join them and return with `.html_safe`


### System configuration
**Rails version**: 6+ (main is still affected)

**Ruby version**: any
comments:
You can simply specify `:sanitize => false` in highlight call like so:
`highlight("xxx yyy & zzz", "a", sanitize: false)`

This will avoid escaping special characters, so highlight will not treat `&` character as string`&` which will match with the phrase "a" to match and highlight it.
@fgiannattasio It will also not sanitize any of the text, raising potential security issues. This is not a correct solution.

I can reproduce the issue. Steps to repro:

```
$ bin/rails c
myapp(dev)> include ActionView::Helpers::TextHelper
myapp(dev)> highlight("xxx yyy & zzz", "a")

=> "xxx yyy &<mark>a</mark>mp; zzz"
```

I don't know if it is worth fixing this issue for 2 reasons:

1. You can easily work around it by doing

    ```ruby
    sanitize(highlight("xxx yyy & zzz", "a", sanitize: false))
    # => "xxx yyy & zzz"
    ```

2. The code doing the highlighting has been optimized in PR [#47339](https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/) by @fatkodima: https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/b8720e7cb8c9894d142b8576c21065c92cd1907a/actionview/lib/action_view/helpers/text_helper.rb#L180-L192

    So changing that code may introduce slowdowns for large inputs.

This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not been commented on for at least three months.
The resources of the Rails team are limited, and so we are asking for your help.
If you can still reproduce this error on the `8-0-stable` branch or on `main`, please reply with all of the information you have about it in order to keep the issue open.
Thank you for all your contributions.

review_comments:
The `(?<!&)` negative lookbehind as it is seems incomplete.

`highlight("x & y", "am")` would result in a desired `"x & y"` output where nothing is highlighted. But `highlight("x & y", "mp")` would result in an undesired `"x &a<mark>mp</mark>; y"` output because `mp` is not immediately preceded by `&`. But it is still part of the overall `&` html entity.
